name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Online trading platform integrating APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
eligibility: Farmers, traders, and FPOs registered with linked APMC mandis.
benefits: Better price discovery, transparent bidding, wider buyer reach, reduced intermediaries.
application_steps: Link APMC mandi and bank account.
Payment settled to farmer account post-trade.
